# coolify_integration_tokens (Data Source)

Lists Coolify integration tokens for the current team. Requires Coolify >= v4.6.0. Secrets and metadata are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_integration_tokens" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `integration_tokens` (Attributes List) Integration tokens on the team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--integration_tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_tokens`

Read-Only:

- `automatic_dns` (Boolean) Cloudflare automatic DNS.
- `capabilities` (List of String) Stored capabilities.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `dns_zones_count` (Number) Cloudflare zone count.
- `integration_provider` (String) Integration provider.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration token.
- `proxied_dns` (Boolean) Cloudflare proxied DNS.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
- `uuid` (String) Integration token UUID.
- `zones_synced_at` (String) When Cloudflare zones were last read.
